thread:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — NorthGrid renewal is slipping. Procurement just told us signer changed and they need a split invoice (platform vs. professional services). They asked for updated pricing and an outline of what gets invoiced now vs. later.
Raj Patel: Ack. Did they confirm term length? (9mo vs 12mo affects proration)
Mia Chen: They were leaning 9mo to align with fiscal close. Also procurement wants a PO; they asked if we can accept a PO for the platform portion and CC for services.
Omar Ruiz: Can we do mixed payment? I think finance can accept PO for recurring seat charge, CC for onboarding. @Lucy can confirm.
Lucy Nguyen: We can accept split payment but need updated SOW and invoice lines separated. Also need the exact legal entity and VAT details.
Priya Sinha: Legal: if signer changed we need new signatory name + title + email and a delegated signing authority doc if not on the contract. If they want a 9mo term, we need to update the contract term.
Raj Patel: I can get signer contact today. @Mia can you draft a payment summary I can share with procurement? Keep it one-pager.
Mia Chen: Will do. Draft coming in ~30m. Also capturing customer feedback: they asked for clearer onboarding milestones and a single enablement owner. Suggest we offer a 1-hour kickoff + 3 milestone check-ins. Thoughts?
Omar Ruiz: +1 on kickoff + milestones. Recommend we commit to an SOC-2 readout and a dedicated CSM for first 90 days. That helps remove renewal risk.
Lucy Nguyen: Add a line about invoicing cadence (monthly vs upfront). Procurement asked for monthly platform billing.
Priya Sinha: I'll prepare a short amendment template for 9mo term + delegated signer clause. Can someone drop the current signed contract and the proposed SOW details here?
Mia Chen: Dropping SOW summary below:
```
SOW summary for NorthGrid:
- Platform seats: 200 seats, monthly billing, $0.XX per seat
- Professional services: Onboarding + integration, one-time fee $25k, billed on CC
- Enablement: 1x kickoff (1h), 3x milestone reviews (weeks 2, 6, 12)
- SLA: standard dedicated SLA (99.9% uptime)
```
Mia Chen: @Raj I'll send signer info and procurement contact once I have it. Planning to include enablement options and an explicit split-invoice note.
Raj Patel: Thanks. I'll ping procurement and ask for PO timeline. If they can issue PO within 3 business days we should be fine.
Lucy Nguyen: Once we have PO + signer, finance will generate two invoice templates and a payment instruction PDF.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a1b2c). Recipient: new_signer@northgrid.com — status: waiting for recipient.
Mia Chen: Great — I'll follow up with NorthGrid to confirm recipient got the envelope and to nudge procurement for PO. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
Omar Ruiz: I can take the enablement scheduling once contract changes are final. Assign to me for kickoff coordination.
Priya Sinha: Copy of amendment template posted below. Use this to update term and signer block. I can review before we send.
Mia Chen: Closing loop: owners — Raj (procurement/PO), Lucy (finance invoicing), Priya (amendment/legal), Omar (enablement), Mia (customer comms & handoff). Will update thread with PO and signer by EOD.
Raj Patel: On it.
Mia Chen: Update 35m later: procurement confirmed they will issue PO tomorrow AM. Signer reply pending — I have phone call scheduled for 10:30 PT. Will update after call. :phone:
Mia Chen: Update 1h later: signer confirmed and delegated signing doc attached (uploaded to shared drive). DocuSign envelope re-sent to new email. PO expected tomorrow.
Mia Chen: Final: PO arrived 2024-08-16 09:12 UTC (attached). Legal approved amendment, DocuSign completed. Finance to send split invoices Monday. Thanks team! :tada:
